“
G-get away! Please, no more!
„
— Liam

Involvement

Act One

Liam is one of the adventurers who accompanied  Aradin Beno to the Shattered Sanctum in hopes of finding the Nightsong. According to  Remira, Liam was the first to charge the goblins, but the other adventurers thought he was reckless and left him to his fate.

Liam is in the Shattered Sanctum being interrogated by  Torturer Spike and  Grush. The party can show the goblins how to properly torture their prisoner. If successful, Liam reveals the location of the Emerald Grove and Torturer Spike reports the information to  Minthara. Doing so grants the ⁠Grabbing the Poker with Both Hands to party members with the Haunted One background.

After the goblins leave, Liam does not believe the party is on his side and claims they could have killed him. The party can attempt to calm him and then ask him about  Halsin and his search for the Nightsong.

Alternatively, the party can free Liam by killing the goblins or convincing Torturer Spike to leave. If successfully released, Liam flees through a hidden exit in the same room, and party members with the Folk Hero background gain the ⁠Fate Worse Than Death inspiration. He then moves to the Emerald Grove next to his fellow adventures to rest (if Aradin's adventurers remained in the Emerald Grove and are still alive).
